en.title: Wearable data → bot email health dashboard
en.summary: Send wearable data (e.g. RingConn) straight to your Grok Bot email address and get back a dashboard plus recommendations to improve health habits.
en.whyItWorks: Exports already leave the wearable as email or files. Pointing them at the bot inbox turns passive data dumps into a readable daily briefing without building a custom app.
workflowSteps: Enable export or email delivery from your wearable account to your Grok Bot inbox.
Instruct the bot to parse sleep, activity, and recovery-style fields into a fixed dashboard layout.
Ask for a short recommendations section tied only to patterns visible in the data you sent.
Add a daily routine that summarizes the latest export if mail arrived.
Review recommendations yourself before changing medication, training, or clinical plans.
en.promptTemplate:
You receive wearable exports at this inbox.

When new data arrives, produce:
1) Dashboard — sleep, activity, resting indicators (only fields present in the export)
2) Changes vs the previous export (if available)
3) 3 practical recommendations grounded in the data

Label speculation clearly. Do not diagnose disease or prescribe treatment. Ask me before any external share.
en.connectorsAndRoutines: Wearable → email/export into the bot inbox is the primary connector. Optional daily routine to render the dashboard when new mail lands. Keep medical decisions human-owned.

setupSteps.title: Send wearable exports to your Grok Bot inbox
setupSteps.detail: Enable export or email delivery from the wearable account (for example RingConn). Connectors this case lists: Bot inbox, Wearable export / email, and Routine (daily).

setupSteps.title: Send the prompt template on this page
setupSteps.detail: The dashboard covers sleep, activity, and resting indicators, using only fields present in the export. If a previous export exists, include what changed.

setupSteps.title: Ask for recommendations tied only to that data
setupSteps.detail: 3 practical recommendations grounded in what you sent. Speculation is labeled clearly. The bot does not diagnose a disease or prescribe treatment.

setupSteps.title: Optionally add a daily routine
setupSteps.detail: When new mail has arrived, it summarizes the latest export.

setupSteps.title: Review before you change a plan
setupSteps.detail: Review recommendations yourself before changing medication, training, or clinical plans. The bot asks before any external share.

acceptanceChecklist: A wearable export sent to the bot inbox comes back as a dashboard of sleep, activity, and resting indicators, using only fields present in that export.
When a previous export is available, the reply includes what changed versus that export.
The reply includes 3 practical recommendations grounded in the data you sent, and speculation is labeled clearly.
The bot does not diagnose a disease or prescribe treatment, asks before any external share, and leaves medication, training, and clinical-plan changes for you to review.
When the optional daily routine runs and new mail has arrived, it summarizes the latest export.

zh.title: 可穿戴数据 → Bot 邮箱健康看板
zh.summary: 把可穿戴设备数据（如 RingConn）直接发到 Grok Bot 邮箱，收回一份看板以及改善健康习惯的建议。
zh.whyItWorks: 设备本来就会以邮件或文件导出。指向 Bot 收件箱，就能把被动数据堆变成可读的每日简报，无需自建应用。
workflowSteps: 在可穿戴账号里开启导出或邮件投递到 Grok Bot 收件箱。
要求 Bot 把睡眠、活动、恢复类字段解析成固定看板布局。
只要一份建议区，且仅依据你发来的数据中可见的模式。
加每日例行：若有新邮件则汇总最新导出。
在调整用药、训练或诊疗计划前，自行审阅建议。
zh.promptTemplate:
本收件箱会收到可穿戴导出。

有新数据时输出：
1）看板 — 睡眠、活动、静息相关指标（仅使用导出中存在的字段）
2）相对上次导出的变化（若有）
3）3 条基于数据的可行建议

推测请明确标注。不要诊断疾病或开处方。对外分享前先问我。
zh.connectorsAndRoutines: 主连接是可穿戴 → 邮件/导出进入 Bot 收件箱。可选每日例行在新邮件到达时生成看板。医疗决策由人负责。

setupSteps.title: 把可穿戴导出送到 Grok Bot 收件箱
setupSteps.detail: 在可穿戴账号里开启导出或邮件投递（例如 RingConn）。本案例列出的连接器：Bot inbox、Wearable export / email、Routine (daily)。

setupSteps.title: 把本页的提示词模板发出去
setupSteps.detail: 看板包含睡眠、活动和静息相关指标，且只用该导出里实际有的字段。若有上一次导出，写上相对那次的变化。

setupSteps.title: 只要依据这份数据的建议
setupSteps.detail: 3 条基于你所发数据的可行建议。推测会明确标出。Bot 不会诊断疾病或开处方。

setupSteps.title: 可选：加一条每日例行
setupSteps.detail: 有新邮件到达时，汇总最新的一次导出。

setupSteps.title: 改计划之前自己先看一遍
setupSteps.detail: 调整用药、训练或诊疗计划前，自行审阅建议。对外分享前 Bot 会先问你。

acceptanceChecklist: 发到 Bot 收件箱的可穿戴导出会返回看板，包含睡眠、活动和静息相关指标，且只用该导出里实际有的字段。
若有上一次导出，回复会包含相对那次导出的变化。
回复包含 3 条基于你所发数据的可行建议，推测会被明确标出。
Bot 不会诊断疾病或开处方，对外分享前会先问你，用药、训练或诊疗计划的调整留给你自己审阅。
可选的每日例行在有新邮件到达时，会汇总最新的一次导出。
